{{Quote|A tender cut of pork imported directly from Gamorr, prepared with a tigmary dry rub and pan-fried to perfection. Served smothered in rich snoruuk gravy.|Dex's Diner on its Gamorrean pork chop|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Snoruuk gravy''' was a type of [[Gravy/Legends|gravy]] served with the [[Gamorrean pork chop]]s sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Sauce/Legends|gravy]] shared its name with the [[snoruuk mushroom]]s found<ref name="Free-Trader's Guide">{{JournalCite|10|A Free-Trader's Guide to the Planets}}</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], the same planet that the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] imported the [[pork]] it used for its pork chops.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Snoruuk gravy was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
